100	            CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS dimension_quality (
101	                dimension TEXT NOT NULL,
102	                query_type TEXT NOT NULL,
103	                k_facts INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
104	                t_facts INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
105	                q_facts INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
106	                sessions INTEGER DEFAULT 1,
107	                last_updated TEXT,
108	                PRIMARY KEY (dimension, query_type)
109	            )
110	        """)
111	        existing = conn.execute(
112	            "SELECT k_facts, t_facts, q_facts, sessions FROM dimension_quality "
113	            "WHERE dimension=? AND query_type=?", (dimension, query_type)
114	        ).fetchone()
115	        
116	        if existing:
117	            conn.execute(
118	                "UPDATE dimension_quality SET k_facts=k_facts+?, t_facts=t_facts+?, "
119	                "q_facts=q_facts+?, sessions=sessions+1, last_updated=? "
120	                "WHERE dimension=? AND query_type=?",
121	                (facts_in_zone_k, facts_in_zone_t, facts_in_zone_q,
122	                 datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(), dimension, query_type),
123	            )
124	        else:
125	            conn.execute(
126	                "INSERT INTO dimension_quality VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, 1, ?)",
127	                (dimension, query_type, facts_in_zone_k, facts_in_zone_t,
128	                 facts_in_zone_q, datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()),
